calls.statement:
SELECT count(*) AS n, count(DISTINCT sales_line_id) AS dist_id, count(DISTINCT (receipt_id, line_no)) AS dist_rl,
       min(sale_date), max(sale_date), min(etl_loaded_at), max(etl_loaded_at),
       count(DISTINCT etl_loaded_at) AS loads
FROM fact_sales_line
WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-05-01' AND DATE '2026-08-10'

WITH web_dispatch AS (
  SELECT web_order_id, status, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date,
         CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', order_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS order_date
  FROM fact_web_order
),
lines AS (
  SELECT f.receipt_id, f.net_amount, f.staff_purchase_flag, s.store_id, p.category,
         CASE WHEN s.store_id = 900 THEN w.dispatch_date ELSE f.sale_date END AS biz_date,
         f.sale_date, w.order_date, w.status
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
  LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id=f.receipt_id
)
SELECT CASE WHEN store_id=900 THEN 'web' WHEN store_id=999 THEN '999' ELSE 'store' END AS ch,
       category='ZZ Test' AS test, staff_purchase_flag AS staff, status,
       count(DISTINCT receipt_id) AS receipts, sum(net_amount) AS net
FROM lines
WHERE biz_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-05-04' AND DATE '2026-08-02'
GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1,2,3,4

SELECT status, fulfilment_type,
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', order_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) BETWEEN DATE '2026-05-04' AND DATE '2026-08-02') AS by_order_date,
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) BETWEEN DATE '2026-05-04' AND DATE '2026-08-02') AS by_dispatch_date,
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE CAST(order_ts_utc AS DATE) BETWEEN DATE '2026-05-04' AND DATE '2026-08-02') AS by_utc_order_date,
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE line_count IS NULL OR line_count=0) AS zero_lines,
  count(*) AS total
FROM fact_web_order GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1,2

WITH web_dispatch AS (
  SELECT web_order_id, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
  FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered','collected')
),
lines AS (
  SELECT f.receipt_id, f.net_amount, f.staff_purchase_flag, s.store_id,
         COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
  LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id=f.receipt_id
  WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
),
ctl AS (
  SELECT sum(net_sales_before_returns) AS ctl_gross, sum(receipts) AS ctl_receipts
  FROM rpt_daily_store_sales WHERE business_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-05-04' AND DATE '2026-08-02'
)
SELECT sum(net_amount) FILTER (WHERE NOT staff_purchase_flag) AS net_ex_staff,
       count(DISTINCT receipt_id) FILTER (WHERE NOT staff_purchase_flag) AS receipts_ex_staff,
       sum(net_amount) FILTER (WHERE NOT staff_purchase_flag AND store_id<900) AS store_net,
       count(DISTINCT receipt_id) FILTER (WHERE NOT staff_purchase_flag AND store_id<900) AS store_receipts,
       sum(net_amount) FILTER (WHERE store_id=900) AS web_net, count(DISTINCT receipt_id) FILTER (WHERE store_id=900) AS web_receipts,
       sum(net_amount) AS net_incl_staff, count(DISTINCT receipt_id) AS receipts_incl_staff,
       any_value(ctl_gross) AS ctl_gross, any_value(ctl_receipts) AS ctl_receipts,
       round(sum(net_amount) FILTER (WHERE NOT staff_purchase_flag) / count(DISTINCT receipt_id) FILTER (WHERE NOT staff_purchase_flag), 2) AS atv
FROM lines CROSS JOIN ctl
WHERE business_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-05-04' AND DATE '2026-08-02'
